use default

let english = [
    0.08167, 0.01492, 0.02782, 0.04253, 0.12702, 0.02228, 0.02015,
    0.06094, 0.06966, 0.00153, 0.00772, 0.04025, 0.02406, 0.06749,
    0.07507, 0.01929, 0.00095, 0.05987, 0.06327, 0.09056, 0.02758,
    0.00978, 0.02360, 0.00150, 0.01974, 0.00074
]

ord(c: char) -> int => cast int(c) - cast int('A')

chr(n: int) -> char => cast char(cast int('A') + (n % 26 + 26) % 26)

sum(values: Iterable[double]) -> double =>
    values |> reduce(0.0, (a, b) => a + b)

counts(text: string) -> int[] =>
    (0..26)
        |> map(letter => text |> filter(c => ord(c) == letter) |> count())
        |> collect_array()

column(text: string, length: int, start: int) -> string =>
    text
        |> index()
        |> filter(c => c.index % length == start)
        |> map(c => c.value)
        |> join("")

coincidence(text: string) -> double =>
    sum(counts(text) |> map(n => cast double(n * (n - 1)))) /
    cast double(text.length * (text.length - 1))

shift(text: string, by: int) -> string =>
    text |> map(c => chr(ord(c) - by)) |> join("")

chi_squared(text: string) -> double =>
    sum(counts(text)
        |> index()
        |> map(n => (
            let expected = english[n.index] * cast double(text.length)
            let difference = cast double(n.value) - expected
            difference * difference / expected)))

best_shift(text: string) -> int =>
    (0..26) |> reduce(0, (best, by) =>
        if chi_squared(shift(text, by)) < chi_squared(shift(text, best))
        then by else best fi)

decrypt(text: string, key: string) -> string =>
    text
        |> index()
        |> map(c => chr(ord(c.value) - ord(key[c.index % key.length])))
        |> join("")

let cipher =
    "MOMUD EKAPV TQEFM OEVHP AJMII CDCTI FGYAG JSPXY ALUYM NSMYH "
    "VUXJE LEPXJ FXGCM JHKDZ RYICU HYPUS PGIGM OIYHF WHTCQ KMLRD "

    "FGRPH JOOFW GUBYI LAPLA LCAFA AMKLG CETDW VOELJ IKGJB XPHVG "
    "ALWQC SNWBU BYHCU HKOCE XJEYK BQKVY KIIEH GRLGH XEOLW AWFOJ "
    "ILOVV RHPKD WIHKN ATUHN VRYAQ DIVHX FHRZV QWMWV LGSHN NLVZS "
    "JLAKI FHXUF XJLXM TBLQV RXXHR FZXGV LRAJI EXPRV OSMNP KEPDT "
    "LPRWM JAZPK LQUZA ALGZX GVLKL GJTUI ITDSU REZXJ ERXZS HMPST "
    "MTEOE PAPJH SMFNB YVQUZ AALGA YDNMP AQOWT UHDBV TSMUE UIMVH "
    "QGVRW AEFSP EMPVE PKXZY WLKJA GWALT VYYOB YIXOK IHPDS EVLEV "
    "RVSGB JOGYW FHKBL GLXYA MVKIS KIEHY IMAPX UOISK PVAGN MZHPW "
    "TTZPV XFCCD TUHJH WLAPF YULTB UXJLN SIJVV YOVDJ SOLXG TGRVO "
    "SFRII CTMKO JFCQF KTINQ BWVHG TENLH HOGCS PSFPV GJOKM SIFPR "
    "ZPAAS ATPTZ FTPPD PORRF TAXZP KALQA WMIUD BWNCT LEFKO ZQDLX "
    "BUXJL ASIMR PNMBF ZCYLV WAPVF QRHZV ZGZEF KBYIO OFXYE VOWGB "
    "BXVCB XBAWG LQKCM ICRRX MACUO IKHQU AJEGL OIJHH XPVZW JEWBA "
    "FWAML ZZRXJ EKAHV FASMU LVVUT TGK "

let letters = cipher |> filter(c => char.is_letter(c)) |> join("")

let average_coincidence = (length: int) =>
    sum((0..length)
        |> map(i => coincidence(column(letters, length, i)))) /
    cast double(length)

let length =
    (1::20) |> find(length => average_coincidence(length) > 0.06) ?? 1

let key =
    (0..length)
        |> map(i => chr(best_shift(column(letters, length, i))))

let plain = decrypt(letters, key)

for line in 0..(plain.length + 59) / 60 do
    write_line(plain |> skip(line * 60) |> take(60) |> join(""))
